name: io.github.mario-andreschak/mcp-abap-abap-adt-api
description: MCP server wrapping abap-adt-api for ABAP ADT development workflows against SAP systems

environmentVariables.name: SAP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the SAP system, e.g. https://host:44300

environmentVariables.name: NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a trusted private CA certificate bundle; TLS verification remains enabled

environmentVariables.name: SAP_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional broker-issued SAP bearer token instead of SAP_PASSWORD; restart to rotate

environmentVariables.name: SAP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Total operation budget in milliseconds (100..120000; default 60000)
